scope: completed RARS evidence through the independently audited V14 negative diagnostic plus the frozen, not-yet-run V15 selective-gate protocol
metric_semantics: known-positive retrieval metrics unless the source explicitly states otherwise; values from different query roles, corpora, models, and candidate protocols are not pooled

experiments.result: compact residual variants improve some M32 bases, but a uniform rebuilt M48 index remains stronger at comparable representation bytes
experiments.lesson: a sidecar must be justified by the frozen-index retrofit constraint, not by global storage optimality when rebuilding is allowed

experiments.audit: 137 of 1000 queries had prior exploration; on the remaining 863, Recall, Success, and nDCG remain positive while MRR CI crosses zero
experiments.lesson: the frozen sidecar can help Base, but this does not establish RARS over a storage-matched PCA comparator
point estimates transfer, but neither interval excludes zero
small query count and restricted corpus create high variance, and the primary direction is negative
candidate-level exact headroom exists, but the learned score-error proxy is weakly aligned with relevance
a training objective that is not evaluated through the deployable int8 Top-B scorer can catastrophically optimize the wrong system
making the scorer deployable is necessary but does not make the retrieval-aware objective better than PCA

experiments.failed_support: seed 44 improves 10 queries over PCA versus the registered minimum of 11
experiments.lesson: mean gain and positive confidence intervals are insufficient when the effect is carried by too few queries
a label-aware adaptive storage allocator did not expose the preregistered advantage over strong fixed-rate access, so static variable-rate allocation was abandoned
a near-ceiling 100K task supplies too little PQ-specific supervision; the adapter overfits and harms Recall@10
PQ-specific headroom is real and distributed, but routing accounts for most remaining Base-to-exact loss
moving the query to compensate document-side PQ residuals creates unacceptable representation drift and uncertain retrieval gain

experiments.optimizer_anomaly: recorded surrogate loss rises from 0.07568628906025816 to 0.08769166847680343; no convergence claim
experiments.lesson: this is the first development result that beats both Base and storage-matched PCA with broad query support, but it still requires one-shot confirmation
a compact residual sidecar is supported over Base within this program, but every registered RARS-over-PCA algorithm gate fails and rebuild-allowed M48 remains stronger
experiments.source: user-returned audited rars-v9-confirmation-a7b889a5aa01.zip; protocol source is protocols/rars_v9_locked_confirmation_v1.json

experiments.lesson: the numerically audited harm-constrained optimizer remains stable but collapses close to PCA and does not establish PCA superiority; rank-16 scalar quantization explains only a negligible fraction of the remaining same-candidate gap

experiments.primary_capacity_comparison: PCA rank64 FP32 minus PCA rank16 int8
experiments.primary_16_byte_comparison: PCA rank64 RPQ16x8 minus PCA rank16 int8
experiments.pre_metric_implementation_repair: the first 08bf7184acc7 attempt wrote only diagnostic_started.json and stopped because the Colab Faiss 1.12 ProductQuantizer binding lacks is_trained; the version-specific check was replaced by centroid/code/round-trip postconditions without changing the protocol
experiments.lesson: rank-64 residual capacity survives a 16-byte product code and is materially stronger than rank-16 scalar PCA, but V11 contains no cutoff-aware training and therefore establishes capacity rather than algorithm success

experiments.query_population: MS MARCO passage-ranking train queries with at least one positive passage in the frozen 1M corpus, excluding every qid in the historical 6980-query split
experiments.baseline: per-fold rank64 PCA plus Faiss RPQ16x8 at exactly 16 bytes per document
experiments.method: one closed-form PCA-anchored cutoff-aware centroid update inside the frozen initial RPQ partition, followed by reassignment
experiments.lesson: V12 decreases its unsigned residual reconstruction objective but does not stably improve ranking: the primary confidence interval crosses zero, support is only 8 versus 8, one seed is negative, and three folds regress. The next method must fit signed query-residual score error rather than unsigned vector reconstruction.

experiments.query_population: new MS MARCO train queries with corpus-covered positives, excluding all historical 6980 qids and all 2500 V12 qids
experiments.baseline: per-fold rank64 PCA plus Faiss RPQ16x8 and a storage-matched PCA16-int8 comparator, each exactly 16 bytes per document
experiments.method: fixed-assignment per-centroid 4x4 ridge regression of signed query-residual block scores, cutoff-weighted and query-covariance anchored, with no code reassignment
experiments.changed_query_seed_overlap: 29 changed qids across three seeds, with zero pairwise or three-way overlap
experiments.lesson: the signed-score surrogate decreases in every fold and seed, but only nine primary-seed queries change Recall and the changed-query identities do not repeat across seeds; surrogate improvement is not stable ranking improvement

experiments.query_role: reused V13 development queries; explicitly not fresh evidence
experiments.baseline: committed V13 per-seed uniform PCA64 RPQ16x8 arrays at exactly 16 bytes per document
experiments.method: label-free cutoff-query covariance, per-block score whitening, exact bounded integer allocation of 128 bits across sixteen four-dimensional blocks, and transformed-space k-means
experiments.lesson: the non-uniform allocation is identical across all folds and the exact 16-byte payload is valid, but whitening lowers quality and rate allocation only partially recovers that loss; the primary comparison is negative, its interval crosses zero, three folds regress, and improved/harmed support is balanced

experiments.query_role: reused V13 development queries; explicitly not fresh evidence
experiments.baseline: committed V13 per-seed uniform PCA64 RPQ16x8 arrays at exactly 16 bytes per document
experiments.method: one preregistered cross-fitted weighted-ridge query gate selects the complete uniform-sidecar ranking or untouched Base ranking from twelve label-free score features
experiments.lesson: V15 changes no document representation; it tests whether predicted query-level correction utility can reduce always-on sidecar harm without candidate-level outcome mixing
